message: 力

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh?」

name: Melilot
message: 「W-Wait...! H-Helena, where are you touching? Please stop!」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm groping your boobs\s04 Not gonna stooop♪」
Just faintly, I can hear the exchange between Melilot-san and Helena-san.
Looking over, the chairwoman's office door is slightly ajar. Knowing it's wrong, I can't help peeking inside.

name: Melilot
message: 「Suddenly doing this without any warning...!」

name: Helena
message: 「Yep, it's a dry run. Next time I'll ambush you in the library~」

name: Helena
message: 「You can protest out loud here, but talking is strictly forbidden there... You won't even be able to make a sound, you know?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena. That's a terribly dirty-old-man way of thinking, you know?」

name: Helena
message: 「You're the one to blame for awakening the man inside me.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Geez! Please stop fooling around!」
Melilot-san slips free from Helena-san's hold.

name: Melilot
message: 「Even without playing pranks on someone like me... look」
Melilot-san's hand touches Helena-san's cheek.

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena, your skin is so beautiful」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot...」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's brimming with everything. Energy, moisture, good fortune, dreams, the future--it's packed with all of it」

name: Melilot
message: 「...It's nothing like my skin, where the magic seems to have rusted away...」

name: Helena
message: 「To my eyes, you look the exact same way, you know?」
Helena-san clasps Melilot-san's hand tightly.

name: Helena
message: 「See, if I do this, I don't just see it--I can feel it too」

name: Helena
message: 「Melilot's hand is overflowing with a great power striving to grasp an unseen future」

name: Melilot
message: 「Helena...」
I quietly step away from the door.
I'm sorry--I apologize in my heart to Melilot-san and Helena-san. I shouldn't peek any further; both of them are people I respect.
...In the remaining year and a half of my academy life, will I be able to find comrades who can encourage each other like that?
Thinking about such things, I head toward the Student Council room.
